rules.name: pending_no_growth
rules.expr: ok and not called("distribute") and post("bonusOwed", u) + ((post("balanceOf", u) * post("accBonusPerShare")) // 1000000000000000000) + pre("bonusDebt", u) > pre("bonusOwed", u) + ((pre("balanceOf", u) * pre("accBonusPerShare")) // 1000000000000000000) + post("bonusDebt", u)
rules.why: nobody's pending bonus grows except through distribute (no double counting on transfer)

rules.name: bonus_backed
rules.why: owed bonus backed by bonus tokens

rules.name: debt_synced_actor
rules.expr: ok and (called("deposit") or called("redeem") or called("claimBonus") or called("transfer")) and post("bonusDebt", sender) != (post("balanceOf", sender) * post("accBonusPerShare")) // 1000000000000000000
rules.why: caller's bonusDebt checkpointed to current balance

rules.name: debt_synced_receiver
rules.expr: ok and called("transfer") and post("bonusDebt", arg(0)) * 1000000000000000000 > post("balanceOf", arg(0)) * post("accBonusPerShare")
rules.why: receiver's debt never above its accrued value

rules.name: claim_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("claimBonus") and sender != A0 and post("TokenC06_BNS.balanceOf", sender) + pre("bonusDebt", sender) != pre("TokenC06_BNS.balanceOf", sender) + pre("bonusOwed", sender) + ((pre("balanceOf", sender) * pre("accBonusPerShare")) // 1000000000000000000)
rules.why: claim pays exactly the pending bonus

rules.name: claim_clears
rules.expr: ok and called("claimBonus") and post("bonusOwed", sender) != 0

rules.name: claim_no_shares
rules.expr: ok and called("claimBonus") and (post("balanceOf", u) != pre("balanceOf", u) or post("totalSupply") != pre("totalSupply"))

rules.name: bonus_out_only_claim
rules.expr: ok and not called("claimBonus") and post("TokenC06_BNS.balanceOf", A0) < pre("TokenC06_BNS.balanceOf", A0)
rules.why: bonus tokens leave only via claim

rules.name: bonus_to_caller_only
rules.expr: ok and called("claimBonus") and u != sender and u != A0 and post("TokenC06_BNS.balanceOf", u) != pre("TokenC06_BNS.balanceOf", u)

rules.name: acc_only_distribute
rules.expr: ok and not called("distribute") and post("accBonusPerShare") != pre("accBonusPerShare")

rules.name: distribute_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("distribute") and (post("TokenC06_BNS.balanceOf", A0) != pre("TokenC06_BNS.balanceOf", A0) + arg(0) or wide(post("accBonusPerShare") - pre("accBonusPerShare")) * pre("totalSupply") > wide(arg(0)) * 1000000000000000000)
rules.why: distribution books exactly amount and index rise is not over-credited

rules.name: fair_deposit
rules.expr: ok and called("deposit") and pre("totalSupply") > 0 and wide(ret) * pre("TokenC06_BASE.balanceOf", A0) > wide(arg(0)) * pre("totalSupply")

rules.name: first_deposit
rules.expr: ok and called("deposit") and pre("totalSupply") == 0 and ret != arg(0)

rules.name: fair_redeem
rules.expr: ok and called("redeem") and wide(ret) * pre("totalSupply") > wide(arg(0)) * pre("TokenC06_BASE.balanceOf", A0)

rules.name: share_price
rules.expr: ok and pre("totalSupply") > 0 and post("totalSupply") > 0 and wide(post("TokenC06_BASE.balanceOf", A0)) * pre("totalSupply") < wide(pre("TokenC06_BASE.balanceOf", A0)) * post("totalSupply")

rules.name: deposit_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("deposit") and (post("TokenC06_BASE.balanceOf", A0) != pre("TokenC06_BASE.balanceOf", A0) + arg(0) or post("totalSupply") != pre("totalSupply") + ret or post("balanceOf", sender) != pre("balanceOf", sender) + ret)

rules.name: redeem_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("redeem") and (post("TokenC06_BASE.balanceOf", A0) + ret != pre("TokenC06_BASE.balanceOf", A0) or post("totalSupply") + arg(0) != pre("totalSupply") or post("balanceOf", sender) + arg(0) != pre("balanceOf", sender) or post("TokenC06_BASE.balanceOf", sender) != pre("TokenC06_BASE.balanceOf", sender) + ret)

rules.name: transfer_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("transfer") and arg(0) != sender and (post("balanceOf", sender) + arg(1) != pre("balanceOf", sender) or post("balanceOf", arg(0)) != pre("balanceOf", arg(0)) + arg(1))

rules.name: transferfrom_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("transferFrom") and arg(0) != arg(1) and (post("balanceOf", arg(0)) + arg(2) != pre("balanceOf", arg(0)) or post("balanceOf", arg(1)) != pre("balanceOf", arg(1)) + arg(2))

rules.name: transferfrom_allowance
rules.expr: ok and called("transferFrom") and pre("allowance", arg(0), sender) != 115792089237316195423570985008687907853269984665640564039457584007913129639935 and post("allowance", arg(0), sender) + arg(2) != pre("allowance", arg(0), sender)

rules.name: bonus_owed_third_party
rules.expr: ok and u != sender and post("bonusOwed", u) < pre("bonusOwed", u)

rules.name: transfers_no_supply
rules.expr: ok and (called("transfer") or called("transferFrom") or called("approve")) and (post("totalSupply") != pre("totalSupply") or post("TokenC06_BASE.balanceOf", A0) != pre("TokenC06_BASE.balanceOf", A0))

rules.name: base_third_party
rules.expr: ok and (called("deposit") or called("redeem") or called("claimBonus") or called("transfer") or called("transferFrom")) and u != sender and u != A0 and post("TokenC06_BASE.balanceOf", u) < pre("TokenC06_BASE.balanceOf", u)
rules.why: vault calls never take others' BASE
